subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw doctor --fix automatically injects plugins.load.paths entry pointing at bundled plugin dir, causing circular warning

question: Is the current proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85358 enough for this persisted-config update fix, or should maintainers require final-head update/channel-sync plus doctor idempotency proof before merge?
rationale: The source fix shape is clear, but the affected surface writes user config during update and doctor repair, so proof sufficiency is a maintainer-owned merge decision.

options.title: Require final-head proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from the current PR head showing update/channel sync, `plugins.load.paths`, `openclaw doctor --fix`, and a repeated idempotency check before merge.

options.title: Accept existing proof
options.body: Merge with the existing source, tests, and copied macOS/VPS proof while owning any upgrade-path compatibility fallout.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a maintainer or contributor can produce the missing live update-path proof.

recommendation.title: Require final-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from the current PR head showing update/channel sync, `plugins.load.paths`, `openclaw doctor --fix`, and a repeated idempotency check before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee on the linked closing PR and has recent relevant plugin update/test commits.
